rules.why: An accepted response must not be returned if publishing work failed without a successful recovery.
rules.question: Can this handler return a successful acceptance response on a path where queue.publish failed and no successful recovery completed?

criteria.true: An exception or rejected publish can reach a success/accepted response after only logging, swallowing the failure, or otherwise failing to recover.
criteria.false: Publish failure leads to an error or non-success response, or a successful retry/recovery is required before reporting acceptance. Do not infer failure paths absent from the selected handler.
